parameters.jsonExample:
{
  "tenant_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
  "date_range_start": "2026-08-17",
  "date_range_end": "2026-08-21",
  "duration_minutes": "60 (optional; 15 and 30 for Elliot's own intro calls and demos)",
  "min_notice_minutes": "0 (optional; how far ahead the first slot must be)"
}

parameters.query:
-- 0038: plus the agency's minimum notice and the buffer around every event.
-- 0042: the agents' own calendars when they have them, else the agency calendar.
select ac.business_hours, ac.google_calendar_id, t.timezone, ac.booking_notice_minutes, ac.booking_buffer_minutes,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(c.calendar_id), '[]'::jsonb) from availability_calendars(ac.tenant_id) c) as calendar_ids
from ai_config ac
join tenants t on t.id = ac.tenant_id
where ac.tenant_id = $1;

nodes.name: Load AI Config
nodes.notes: Set the Postgres credential manually after import. Requires ai_config.google_calendar_id column (add via: alter table ai_config add column google_calendar_id text default 'primary';)
